encoding: bit 0 when the neuron's own spike trace is at least 0.5, otherwise bit 1

channel.targets: first eight VPN neurons of bit lane 0 or 1

selection: Among 42 MBONs and thresholds 0.05, 0.2, 0.5, 1: require conditional information about mapping/correct action given cue above 0.03 bits on each calibration seed, trained mapping-1 bit occupancy 20-80% on each seed, and at least 0.1 mean bit-frequency change from untrained on mapping 1; rank by mean conditional information.
note: Only Fly A neural activity is sampled at transmission time; no answer, mapping label, or weights are transmitted. Calibration teacher evaluation used no reward feedback.
